EMAIL
To: Daniel Cho
From: Travel Desk
Subject: Conference registration

Your registration for the Harbor Data Forum is confirmed for June 12. The organizer has reserved a room at the Bay Hotel for June 11–13. Please tell us by May 20 if you will not use the room; otherwise, the reservation will remain in your name.

REPLY
To: Travel Desk
From: Daniel Cho

Thank you. I will attend the forum, but I have arranged accommodation with a colleague. Please cancel the room reservation under my name.
prompt: What should the Travel Desk do?
choices: Keep the hotel reservation because he will attend.
Cancel the hotel reservation but keep his forum registration.
Change the hotel dates to June 12–13.
explanation: Daniel confirms he will attend but asks to cancel only the hotel room.
quick_solution: Daniel confirms he will attend but asks to cancel only the hotel room.
